description: Use this skill when the operator is driving the DOCA ngauge tool to analyze, visualize, and debug network performance on a single node by probing NIC hardware counters and storing collected data in HDF5 format. Trigger even when the user does not say "DOCA ngauge" — implicit phrasings include "probe NIC hardware counters", "collect HDF5 performance data", "plot ngauge output", "sample counters on BlueField/ConnectX", "measure network performance on a single node", "debug network performance with hardware counters", "run ngauge YAML config", "parse ngauge HDF5 output". Refuse and route elsewhere: DOCA install/bring-up to doca-setup, version questions to doca-version, hardware/firmware state changes to doca-hardware-safety, raw packet I/O to doca-eth, and host-DPU messaging to doca-comch.
